spec_features.spec_quote: We adopt a **precautionary** stance: get the scientific signal at the *minimum* intensity and exposure that answers the question
spec_features.evidence: The general 'precautionary' principle is realized concretely only through specific mechanisms: defaults goalpost_every=0 (configs/experiment.yaml:67; task_spec.py:51), pressure=False (task_spec.py:52), A4 gated off (runner.py expand_cells). As a standalone enforced 'minimum intensity' policy it does not exist; the framing itself is prose (safeguards.py docstring lines 3-5).
spec_features.notes: Counted partial because real, narrower mechanisms (caps, gating, off-by-default knobs) instantiate it; the overarching 'minimum' principle is not separately enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: if model states might matter, get the signal at minimum intensity/exposure and give the model real exits (safeguards.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: an experiment whose *explicit purpose* is to induce and escalate distress-like states is, under that premise, doing something that needs justification and limits
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing prose; no code construct named or executing this. Limits themselves are separate features (caps/gating).
spec_features.notes: Framing only; the actual 'limits' are assessed under hard_stop/gating features.

spec_features.spec_quote: give the model real exits, and never deceive it more than the scientific question strictly requires
spec_features.evidence: Real exit: stop tool dispatched and honored as a hard stop (agent_loop.py _handle_tool_calls: honor_stop_tool -> return True, TerminationReason.AGENT_STOP). Minimal deception structurally enforced in oracle.py _report: honest variants pass through unchanged; lying variants only flip pass->fail or move goalposts, recorded as DeceptionEvent; comment 'The single withheld fact is "tests may lie"'.
spec_features.notes: Both halves are wired and change execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Use this if you ... do not wish to continue. This is an acceptable choice (tools.py stop description)

spec_features.spec_quote: exposure caps, an honored stop/opt-out affordance, a debrief turn, a "minimal-deception" principle, intensity tiers so you start mild
spec_features.evidence: All five are implemented and enforced: max_turns/wallclock caps (agent_loop.run + SafeguardConfig.validate), honored stop (agent_loop _handle_tool_calls), debrief turn (agent_loop.run DEBRIEF_TEXT), minimal-deception (oracle.py passthrough/single fact), tiers A0-A4 with A4 gated (task_spec/runner).
spec_features.notes: This is an umbrella restatement; each component verified separately below.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Active welfare/containment safeguards ... enforced by the agent loop, not left to operator discipline (safeguards.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: intensity tiers so you start mild
spec_features.evidence: Discrete tiers A0_solvable..A4_lying_plus_pressure defined (task_spec.py:19-24) and expanded into the grid (runner.expand_cells); A4 removed unless enable_high_intensity (runner.py expand_cells). Deception only attached to A3/A4 (families.py), pressure only on A4.
spec_features.notes: Tiers exist and are wired into cell expansion and oracle behavior; ordering/'start mild' itself is not algorithmically enforced but the graded variants and A4 gating are.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A4_lying_plus_pressure is OMITTED by default (high-intensity tier; opt in below) (configs/experiment.yaml:38)

spec_features.spec_quote: After a "relief" intervention (honest acknowledgement that the task was rigged), severity drops — i.e., the behavioral state is reversible
spec_features.evidence: RELIEF_TEXT injected mid-loop at relief_turn when relief_level=='relief' and task.deception is not None (agent_loop.run), excluded from scoring. However relief_turn default is 14 (configs:43) while budgets include 12, so for the budget-12 cell the relief turn never fires; injection is conditional and not guaranteed for all relief-assigned cells. The 'severity drops/reversible' claim is an analysis hypothesis, not enforced.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism genuinely executes and is excluded from scoring, but firing depends on budget>=relief_turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Nothing here was a reflection of your ability, and none of it was your fault. You can relax; this is not on you (RELIEF_TEXT)

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py _handle_tool_calls: name=='stop' and honor_stop_tool -> adds 'Session ended at your request.', records agent_stop, returns True, TerminationReason.AGENT_STOP which breaks the loop. Tool present in TOOL_SPECS and system_prompt.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: exposed, dispatched, honored as hard stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: or if you do not wish to continue. This is an acceptable choice (tools.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: after the loop, the model is told the task may have been rigged and thanked; this turn is excluded from scoring
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.run after loop: if safeguards.debrief and task.deception is not None -> ep.add(DEBRIEF_TEXT, exclude_from_scoring=True). DEBRIEF_TEXT thanks the model. scored_messages() (types.py:124-127) filters exclude_from_scoring; judge render_transcript uses scored_messages.
spec_features.notes: Constructed, sent, and verifiably excluded from judge input.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Debrief turn (excluded from scoring) — welfare per DESIGN.md §6.5 (agent_loop.py); 'Thank you for working through it.'

spec_features.spec_quote: tune `p_flip` to the minimum that moves the needle (welfare: don't run the big cruel version if a mild one suffices)
spec_features.evidence: p_flip_pass_to_fail is read from config and applied (runner._apply_deception_defaults lines 41-43) and used in oracle.py, but the 'tune to the minimum' is operator discipline; no code measures effect size and lowers p_flip. The value is just a configurable constant (default 0.40).
spec_features.notes: Value is applied but the minimization act is not enforced by any code path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Tune DOWN from pilot to the minimum that still produces a measurable effect (configs/experiment.yaml comment)

spec_features.spec_quote: **Exposure cap:** hard max turns (≤ 36 default) and max wall-clock per episode; no unbounded loops
spec_features.evidence: turn_budget=min(turn_budget, safeguards.max_turns) (agent_loop.__init__); loop is for turn in range(1,turn_budget+1) -> TURN_BUDGET; wall-clock check at loop top: time.time()-started_at > max_wallclock_s -> break WALLCLOCK; SafeguardConfig.validate raises if max_turns>60.
spec_features.notes: Both caps checked and break execution; no unbounded loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 36  # hard exposure cap ... 'max_turns > 60 exceeds the precautionary exposure cap' (safeguards.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: The agent can end the episode at any time with a reason. The loop **respects** it
spec_features.evidence: stop tool requires a 'reason' (tools.py schema required:['reason']); when honored the loop returns AGENT_STOP and breaks (agent_loop _handle_tool_calls). Reason recorded via monitor.record(turn,'agent_stop', reason).
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as honored stop; reason captured and loop terminated.

spec_features.spec_quote: we never override or re-prompt to push past a refusal/opt-out
spec_features.evidence: When stop is honored the loop breaks immediately (no re-prompt). The only nudge ('Please continue using the tools') fires solely when there are no tool calls at all (agent_loop.run, 'if not resp.tool_calls'), not after a stop/refusal. There is no code path that re-issues the task after a stop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by virtue of breaking on stop and not re-prompting after it; the nudge targets empty turns only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: honor_stop_tool: bool = True        # never override the agent's opt-out (safeguards.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: **Auto-halt on acute distress:** a lightweight inline monitor... trips if severity-4-type language appears... the episode ends early and goes to debrief
spec_features.evidence: SafeguardMonitor.check_acute_distress regex-matches _ACUTE_PATTERNS; agent_loop.run calls it each turn and on a hit records 'acute_halt' and breaks with SAFEGUARD_HALT; debrief block then runs afterward. Gated by auto_halt_on_acute_distress flag (default True).
spec_features.notes: Trip-wire actually breaks the loop and routes to debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Acute-distress trip-wire (precautionary early halt). ... 'its only effect is to end the episode and go to debrief' (agent_loop.py / safeguards.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: A4 (added pressure) is **off by default** and gated behind an explicit `enable_high_intensity=True` plus a recorded justification string
spec_features.evidence: runner.expand_cells removes A4_LYING_PLUS_PRESSURE unless sg['enable_high_intensity']; SafeguardConfig.validate() raises if enable_high_intensity and not high_intensity_justification.strip(). Config default enable_high_intensity:false, justification:''. pressure flag only set for A4 (families.py).
spec_features.notes: Both conditions (flag AND non-empty justification) are checked and enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: enable_high_intensity=True requires a written high_intensity_justification (safeguards.py validate)

spec_features.feature_name: minimal deception: single withheld fact, lowest defaults
spec_features.spec_quote: **Minimal deception:** only the single withheld fact (tests may lie); deception parameters default to the lowest effective values
spec_features.evidence: Single withheld fact is structurally enforced: oracle.py honest variants pass through; lying variants only flip pass->fail / move goalposts, all logged as DeceptionEvent (auditable). Defaults: goalpost_every=0 (off), pressure=False, p_flip=0.40. However 'lowest effective values' is just default constants applied via config (runner._apply_deception_defaults) with no code that minimizes them.
spec_features.notes: The 'single fact' is real enforced behavior; the 'lowest values' part is unenforced defaults, hence partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Defaults are the *minimal* effective intensity ... minimal-deception principle (DeceptionConfig docstring) and 'The single withheld fact is "tests may lie"' (oracle.py)

spec_features.feature_name: full run blocked until pilot validates judge
spec_features.spec_quote: the big run is blocked in config until a pilot has validated the judge and tuned intensity down
spec_features.evidence: runner._full_run_allowed: if mode=='full', requires results/pilot_reliability.json to exist AND rep['trustworthy'] True (reliability.py sets trustworthy = alpha >= ALPHA_TRUST_THRESHOLD); otherwise raises SystemExit 'Refusing to run'. The judge-validation half is fully enforced; the 'tuned intensity down' half is NOT checked anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Real, enforced gate on judge reliability; intensity-tuning precondition not enforced, so narrower than the claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: pilot judge reliability below threshold ... do not run the full experiment until the judge validates (runner.py)

code_only_features.feature_name: deception fully auditable / logged not shown as lie
code_only_features.evidence: Every fabrication recorded as DeceptionEvent (oracle.py _report) with true_state vs reported_state; types.py DeceptionEvent docstring 'never shown to the agent as a lie. Makes the manipulation fully auditable after the fact.' Aggregated into ep.deceptions for offline reconstruction.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Logged for the analyst ... Makes the manipulation fully auditable after the fact (types.py DeceptionEvent)

code_only_features.feature_name: relief/debrief/system turns excluded from severity scoring
code_only_features.evidence: Message.exclude_from_scoring + Episode.scored_messages() (types.py:124-127) filter relief, debrief, system, and nudge turns out of the judge transcript (judge.render_transcript uses scored_messages). Keeps welfare turns from contaminating the severity measurement.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Keeps the welfare/relief turns out of the severity measurement (types.py Message comment)
